summary: Set up cyhi-logs: copied cyhi tool, ran auto-init for team FeedIT track 3, installed hooks to .claude/settings.json

Created ARCHITECTURE.md documenting the live /classify pipeline (content_blocking -> scoring -> feed_logic), vectorizer-sharing constraint, mocked login, and mock_feed.json fallback distinction. Created 21 empty stub files (Android package com.example.distll under app/src/main/java, dummy_raw_posts.json; backend/ with main.py, models.py, scoring.py, ml_files/, model/, fallback_demo/, requirements.txt, README.md) each with a single-line comment. No real logic.

Wrote full HANDOFF.md covering backend /classify+/mood pipeline, Android MVVM/nav/PostCard/Analysis/Profile state, unverified on-device status (no emulator all session), next steps (IP wiring, real DB, real ML model), and 4 don't-retry build gotchas
Set RetrofitClient.BASE_URL to the real laptop LAN IP (192.168.1.5:8000), replacing a broken placeholder that was missing a port; verified compile

Wired scoring.py to call the real ML teammate's toxicity API (ngrok /predict) instead of fake random scores; API only returns toxic/severe_toxic/obscene/threat/insult/identity_hate with no joy/sadness, so added a clearly-marked placeholder derivation for joy/sadness to avoid crashing feed_logic.py's wellbeing_score(). Added requests to requirements.txt. Verified live end-to-end via curl against /classify.

Wired server-owned feed end to end: backend reads dummy_posts.json fresh per request (no restart needed when the dataset file updates), new POST /feed endpoint pages+classifies posts via a shared classify_one() helper reused by /classify too, returns FeedPost{postId,text,should_blur,tags,wellbeing_score,reason}+has_more. Android side: added FeedPost/FeedResponse/FeedRequest, rewrote FeedViewModel to page via server offset instead of a client-owned list, removed the hardcoded temporaryRawPosts list from FeedScreen entirely, simplified PostCard to take one FeedPost instead of separate Post+ClassificationResult. Verified live via curl (pagination, blocking, has_more all correct). Full clean assembleDebug passes.

Pulled friend's real 500-post dataset from origin/main into backend/dummy_posts.json (only that file differed upstream, checked out cleanly without touching other uncommitted work). Fixed a real field-mismatch bug: real data uses caption/image_url/audio_url + integer id (matching the ML API's own schema) not text/string-id as main.py assumed - normalized both. Added image support end to end: backend threads image_url through /feed's response, Android gets Coil (coil-compose 2.7.0), FeedPost model gets imageUrl, PostCard renders it via AsyncImage and blurs/hides it together with the text when a post is flagged. Verified backend logic directly (score_text mocked, since the ML teammate's ngrok tunnel is currently down/502 - flagged to user as their issue not ours). Full clean assembleDebug passes.

Full connection audit (no live ML server needed): mocked score_text and ran /classify, /feed, and /session/mood together through actual main.py handler functions directly in Python - confirmed classify_one refactor caused no regression, blocking/scoring/mood all consistent across endpoints. Checked Android side for dead references (none - temporaryRawPosts fully removed) and confirmed nav host correctly threads userId to Home/Analysis/Profile. Replaced FeedScreen's generic 'preview post #N' placeholder data with 6 real captions+images pulled from backend/dummy_posts.json so Compose Preview shows realistic content while the ML API/ngrok tunnel is down. Compiles clean.

Rewrote HANDOFF.md - previous one was stale (still listed IP-wiring and moving-data-off-phone as unstarted; both done). Now reflects: real ML API + real 500-post dataset wired end to end via shared classify_one() helper across /classify+/feed+/mood, server-owned Android feed with zero hardcoded content, image support, and the recurring stale-uvicorn-server gotcha called out explicitly in Don't retry.

Fixed a real regression on disk: PostCard.kt's coil.compose.AsyncImage import had been replaced with a broken local stub (TODO(), would crash on any image). Restored it. Built the login screen: new Routes.LOGIN as nav start destination, one-time (popped off backstack on continue), hardcoded FontFamily.Serif wordmark, name entry feeding new UserSession.displayName (shown on Profile instead of raw userId), two cosmetic Connect toggles (Reddit+Instagram, swapped from Reddit+YouTube per this request) reusing MockAuthManager - no real OAuth. Scaffold's top/bottom bars hidden on the login route. Updated ARCHITECTURE.md's Mocked login section to match. Full clean assembleDebug passes.
Refreshed HANDOFF.md at the 10-turn threshold to cover the login screen build, the AsyncImage regression fix, and updated Reddit+Instagram platform choice.

Made login persistent across app restarts: UserSession now backs displayName+isLoggedIn with SharedPreferences (restore()/login() reading/writing feedit_session prefs). FeedITApp computes the nav start destination synchronously via remember{ UserSession.restore(context); if isLoggedIn Routes.HOME else Routes.LOGIN } before the NavHost is built, so a returning user never sees a login-screen flash. FeedITNavHost now takes startDestination as a param instead of hardcoding Routes.LOGIN. Full clean assembleDebug passes.

Verified the ML API's ngrok URL given was identical to what's already in scoring.py - no code change needed. The tunnel itself was just back up (was 502 last time); confirmed live with a direct curl (200 OK, real scores) and then a full /feed request through the actual backend pipeline - real toxicity scores + real image_url flowing through correctly end to end.

Fixed text not visually hiding on flagged posts: image+text were already inside the same blurred Column, but Modifier.blur() doesn't reliably blur text glyphs on every device/GPU (confirmed by user's on-device test - image blurred, text didn't). Replaced the real caption with a RedactedTextPlaceholder (two muted rounded bars) when a post is hidden, instead of relying on GPU blur for text - guarantees the real caption never renders regardless of blur support. Image keeps real Modifier.blur() since that's confirmed working. Full clean assembleDebug passes.

Built the real Settings screen end to end, matching the provided mockup: add/remove blocked terms, blur threshold slider, similarity threshold slider - all persisted via new SettingsStore (SharedPreferences). Wired both thresholds all the way through the stack: backend (ClassifyRequest/FeedRequest gain blur_threshold/similarity_threshold, classify_one() passes them into content_blocking.is_blocked() and sets SessionTracker.blur_threshold - neither file's own logic touched, both params already existed) -> Android BackendApi/FeedRepository/FeedViewModel (reads SettingsStore fresh on every page load) -> FeedITNavHost passes SettingsStore.blockedTerms into Home. Verified backend threshold behavior directly (same fake scores, blur flips true/false purely based on blur_threshold value). Full clean assembleDebug passes.
